title: Evaluation and Reliability
description: Measuring LLM features, catching regressions and running them safely in production.

questions.prompt: What is an "eval" in AI application development?

options.text: A repeatable test set with criteria for judging model outputs

questions.explanation: Evals are datasets plus grading criteria. They turn "it seems better" into a measurable comparison across prompt or model changes.

questions.prompt: When is using an LLM as a grader ("LLM-as-judge") most appropriate?

options.text: For nuanced qualities such as helpfulness or tone, with a clear rubric and spot-checked by humans
For exact-match checks like a number
Only when no test data exists

questions.explanation: Model graders scale subjective judgments, but they need precise rubrics and periodic human calibration. Use code for anything exactly checkable.

questions.prompt: Why run your eval suite before shipping a prompt change?

options.text: It is only useful for new features
To detect regressions on cases that previously worked

questions.explanation: A prompt tweak that fixes one case can break others. Running the full suite catches regressions before users do.

questions.prompt: Which is the best defence against hallucinated facts in a support bot?

options.text: Grounding answers in retrieved documents and asking the model to cite or say it does not know

questions.explanation: Grounding plus permission to say "I don't know" reduces fabrication, and citations make answers verifiable.

questions.prompt: What should you log in production for an LLM feature?

options.text: Inputs, outputs, tool calls, latency and errors, with sensitive data handled appropriately

questions.explanation: Traces let you debug failures, build new eval cases from real traffic and monitor cost and latency, while respecting privacy.

questions.prompt: Your model provider has an outage. What is a reasonable resilience strategy?

options.text: Retry instantly in a tight loop
Retry with backoff, fall back to an alternative model or degraded mode, and show a clear message

questions.explanation: Bounded retries with backoff, fallbacks and honest user messaging keep the product usable during partial failures.
